## Hypothesis

We are validating a strategy idea (to be specified) by running Stage-1 backtests for N=2,3,4 parameter variations, followed by walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation to assess robustness and avoid overfit.

## Mechanism

The Stage-1 backtest will iterate over N=2,3,4 (which we interpret as different strategy configurations or parameter sets) over the historical period 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 using real OPRA fills. The top-performing configurations will then be subjected to walk-forward out-of-sample testing (using a rolling window approach) and finally validated on the top 3 J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) with real-fills simulation.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** $25K+ account required for full position sizing (qty=28). $1K paper account scales to ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** The Stage-1 backtest uses the entire available history (16 months) for N=2,3,4 configurations. Selection method: exhaustive grid search over predefined parameter ranges. Overfit risk is high without OOS validation; hence the walk-forward and real-fills steps.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward OOS test not yet performed as part of this analysis; this analysis describes the procedure).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real-fills validation on top 3 J days not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: TBD after backtest; max drawdown: TBD; blow-up scenario: strategy fails during high-volatility regime shifts or liquidity crunches.
6. **Concentration:** TBD after backtest; will disclose if top-5 days contribute >100% of P&L indicating extreme concentration.

## Pre-merge gate

Before any candidate emerging from this validation can be considered for merging, the following must pass:
- Gym validators (e.g., 97/98 tests passing)
- Walk-forward OOS test showing positive expectancy and WF ratio >= 0.70
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days showing consistency with backtested P&L (within ±20%)
- No regression on J anchor days (edge_capture must be >= baseline)
- Concentration disclosure showing top-5 days < 200% of P&L (to avoid extreme reliance on few days)
